method: Boil 2 liters of milk in a vessel. Once boiling, add vinegar to curdle the milk.
Strain it through a clean cloth and squeeze out the water well. This is your paneer.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin and sauté. Add chopped onions and sauté until translucent.
Add turmeric powder, salt, and garam masala, then stir.
Add crushed green chilies and sauté.
Crumble the paneer and add it to the pan. Mix well.
Then add chopped tomatoes and ginger sliced lengthwise.
Sauté well until the tomatoes soften, then sprinkle chopped coriander leaves and remove from heat.
notes: Note: This can also be made with store-bought paneer.
